boundary_principles.heading: trivial task 可以轻量处理，但不能越界

tasks.title: FR-001 Beacon 必须冻结 project-local QA feedback ledger
tasks.description: Beacon 必须为 scheduled QA output 写出 canonical feedback ledger。 至少包含： feature run_id status evidence_done release_ready continue_decision stop_reasons repair_command targeted rerun hints

tasks.title: FR-002 Beacon 必须暴露 feedback ledger 的 public CLI surface
FR-003 Beacon 必须暴露 queue update 的 public CLI surface
FR-004 Queue update 必须保持显式治理
tasks.description: Queue update 只能执行冻结规则，不得产生 opportunistic candidate selection。

tasks.title: FR-005 Nightly QA wrapper 必须在 QA 后刷新 ledger 与 queue
tasks.description: `automation/jobs/beacon-qa-job.sh` 必须在 QA execution 结束后： refresh QA feedback ledger update automation queue

tasks.title: FR-006 Gated implement wrapper 至少必须消费 queue update flow
tasks.description: `automation/jobs/beacon-gated-implement-job.sh` 必须能在 implement window 后刷新 queue state。

tasks.title: FR-007 Capability reporting 必须披露 feedback loop surface
tasks.description: `beacon automation capabilities` 必须显示： feedback ledger path summarize entrypoint update entrypoint

tasks.title: FR-008 该补充必须继续保持 Beacon/host boundary
tasks.description: 该能力必须强化 host-scheduled workflow，但不得把 scheduler runtime 吸收到 Beacon core lifecycle。

tasks.title: FR-009 Beacon 必须暴露 project-local scaffold generation entrypoint
FR-010 Scaffold output 必须是目标项目定制的可运行资产
tasks.description: 至少生成： `automation/beacon-automation-queue.json` `automation/jobs/` `automation/codex/` `automation/launchd/` `automation/README.md` 并将其中的项目路径、queue 路径、输出目录、launchd label 定制到目标项目。

tasks.title: FR-011 Scaffold overwrite 行为必须保守
tasks.description: 默认不得覆盖项目已存在的 automation 文件；只有显式 `--force` 才允许刷新。

tasks.title: FR-012 Beacon 必须冻结 executor capability matrix
tasks.description: 至少区分： executor name tier whether Beacon `implement/qa` can execute through current host runtime whether execution is scaffold-only / adapter-only

tasks.title: FR-013 Scaffold 必须支持 executor profile 生成
tasks.description: 至少提供： `beacon automation init --project-root . --executor codex|claude|cursor|windsurf|trae` 并据此调整 queue target、prompt/spec 说明、以及对 native runtime 是否存在的提示。

tasks.title: FR-014 Beacon 不得把 unsupported executor 伪装成当前可直接跑 implement/qa
tasks.description: 在 `v1.4.6` 中： Codex / Claude 可作为 current Beacon runtime execution hosts Cursor 只能冻结为 adapter-capable, not yet Beacon-native implement/qa runtime Windsurf / Trae 只能冻结为 scaffold/rules/external-scheduler guidance until stronger public execution evidence exists

tasks.title: FR-015 Beacon 必须冻结 shared automation summary schema
tasks.description: Beacon 必须为 automation/jobs 输出一套 transport-agnostic 的 summary schema，供： functional QA exception QA regression QA Beacon nightly strict QA 后续通知适配器 共同消费。 至少包含： `summary_kind` `project_root` `job` `layer` `status` `analysis.headline` `analysis.summary_line` `metrics.*` `features.all` `features.release_ready` `features.repair_needed` `artifacts.*` `notification.title` `notification.lines`

tasks.title: FR-016 Beacon 必须暴露 shared summary 的 public CLI surface
FR-017 Scaffolded wrapper 与通知 helper 必须消费同一 summary schema
tasks.description: `automation/jobs/beacon-qa-job.sh` 与 `automation/jobs/beacon-notify-feishu-post.py` 不得各自发明私有摘要协议。 至少要求： wrapper 通过 Beacon CLI 生成 summary JSON notifier 从 summary JSON 的 `notification` contract 渲染消息 真实项目不需要再手写一版重型 per-project 摘要拼接逻辑才能发通知

tasks.title: FR-018 Beacon 必须暴露 human-facing automation toolkit surface
tasks.description: 至少提供： `beacon-toolkit-automation` 用于： `beacon automation init` `beacon automation capabilities` `beacon automation validate-queue` `beacon automation summarize-qa` `beacon automation build-summary` `beacon automation update-queue` 的初始化、检查、维护路由。 ## 6. 验收标准 | AC ID | 说明 | | --- | --- | | AC-001 | Beacon freezes a project-local QA feedback ledger contract | | AC-002 | Beacon exposes `beacon automation summarize-qa` as public CLI | | AC-003 | Beacon exposes `beacon automation update-queue` as public CLI | | AC-004 | queue update uses explicit pass/repair rules and does not create opportunistic work | | AC-005 | nightly QA wrapper refreshes ledger and queue after QA execution | | AC-006 | gated implement wrapper refreshes queue after implement execution | | AC-007 | automation capability reporting exposes feedback loop surfaces | | AC-008 | the automation/jobs supplement preserves Beacon core lifecycle boundaries | | AC-009 | Beacon exposes `beacon automation init --project-root .` as a public scaffold bootstrap surface | | AC-010 | scaffold output is project-local and rewrites paths/labels for the target repo | | AC-011 | scaffold generation is conservative by default and refreshes only with explicit force | | AC-012 | Beacon freezes a tiered executor capability matrix instead of claiming uniform native automation across all agents | | AC-013 | scaffold generation supports executor profiles and reflects them in queue/spec outputs | | AC-014 | unsupported executors are not represented as current Beacon-native implement/qa runtimes | | AC-015 | Beacon freezes a shared automation summary schema that multiple QA layers and notification adapters can consume | | AC-016 | Beacon exposes `beacon automation build-summary` as a public automation surface | | AC-017 | scaffolded wrappers and notification helpers consume the same summary schema instead of project-specific summary formats | | AC-018 | Beacon exposes a human-facing `beacon-toolkit-automation` support surface for project-local scheduled automation bootstrap and maintenance |

role_semantics.team_reviewer: checks implementation/spec drift before Ralph or QA closure
role_semantics.team_tester: checks implementation evidence and verification readiness before Ralph or QA closure
role_semantics.ralph: post-freeze controller that drives next-action routing across implementation, review, qa, and release

planner.purpose: Compile execution-ready task scope from the frozen revision baseline.

implementation-architect.purpose: Translate frozen requirement truth into implementation-safe module boundaries and service ownership guidance.

implementer.purpose: Write code inside the frozen scope and the implementation architecture note.

reviewer.purpose: Review implementation/spec drift and architecture-boundary drift.

tester.purpose: Check implementation evidence and verification readiness before acceptance.

implementation_preflight: Before implementation, verify the target service belongs to: .
Before implementation, verify the current branch is beacon/v1.4.6.
If a branch switch is needed and the worktree is dirty, stop and clean or stash first.
